research_question: does an anterior-view CNN exceed the E7/E7b reference baselines
success_criterion: pre-specified: the lower bound of the bootstrap 95% CI on the AUROC difference against logistic_age_only must exceed 0 (scripts/14_compare_models.py --reference logistic_age_only)

quality_gate.criterion: at most 5 of 25 folds may have prediction std < 0.05

encoder_selection: fixed in advance; not chosen by comparison (see paper Section on single-view)
loss: BCEWithLogits with pos_weight from the training partition
normalisation: per-image z-score; exports are auto-ranged so ImageNet statistics do not apply

augmentation.horizontal_flip_rationale: mirroring exchanges left and right breast; disease is unilateral
augmentation.photometric_jitter_rationale: images are standardised individually; absolute intensity is not meaningful

model_selection: none: fixed epoch budget, the final model is scored
threshold_rule: balanced accuracy maximized on validation patients of each fold
aggregation: one anterior image per patient; out-of-fold predictions pooled within a repeat
